newsitem.title: GERMANY: Duesseldorf runway to close for summer repairs.
newsitem.headline: Duesseldorf runway to close for summer repairs.

text.p: Duesseldorf Airport will close its main runway for repairs costing 94 million marks this summer, airport authority Flughafen Duesseldorf GmbH said.
But use of a parallel runway from April 1 to October 31 will allow flight operations to continue unaffected, it added.
The main 3,000-metre runway has developed cracks under its surface and requires a complete upgrading following surface repairs in 1982 and 1975, the authority said.

The 2,700-metre parallel runway with extra turning space for long-haul aircraft was completed in 1992 to allow main runway repairs without a break in flights. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
